extraction.Name: William Scissons, Jr.
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 26, 1920, by the Bonesteel State Bank
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to J. P. Treweiler for $6000; in 1923, Scissons conveyed this and some other land to J. P. Treweiler for $1.00 and other valuable consideration, with right to redeem within one year
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739679 issued; South half of Northeast quarter, northeast quarter of northeast quarter section 32, and northwest quarter of northwest quarter section 33, township 97, range 69; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 3, 1920; mortgage executed July 21, 1920
